sources.title: inclusionAI/Ming-3.0-asr-tiny · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Ming-3.-asr-tiny combines the Ling-tiny-v3 language backbone with an audio encoder. It transcribes single-turn Chinese and English speech, covers regional dialects, and can use hotwords or preceding dialogue to improve recognition of domain-specific terms. This repository includes the model weights, tokenizer, custom Transformers implementation, and runnable inference example.
